name: Product Gallery
summary: Controlled rich-media product collection for images, hosted video, external video, and models, with explicit native activation, stable-id selection, optional looping, swipe, and canonical Lightbox image detail.

anatomy.name: main
anatomy.description: Swipe surface and bounded frame for one current media item.

anatomy.name: media
anatomy.description: Stable-id discriminated image, video, external-video, or model record projection.

anatomy.name: imageAction
anatomy.description: Named Button that opens canonical Lightbox only when imageDetail is lightbox.

anatomy.name: poster
anatomy.description: Inactive video or model preview retained until explicit activation.

anatomy.name: activate
anatomy.description: Canonical Button for explicit Play or View in 3D activation.

anatomy.name: nativeContent
anatomy.description: Target-native video, provider, or model viewer lifecycle slot.

anatomy.name: arAction
anatomy.description: Adapter capability action for eligible models; AR is not a media type.

anatomy.name: navigation
anatomy.description: Canonical previous and next Icon Buttons.

anatomy.name: thumbs
anatomy.description: Named ordinary Button group for rich-media thumbnail selection.

anatomy.name: thumb
anatomy.description: Named direct-selection Button with decorative preview and optional canonical media-type Badge.

anatomy.name: mediaBadge
anatomy.description: Context-sized canonical Badge identifying video, external video, or 3D media.

anatomy.name: dots
anatomy.description: Named ordinary Button group for compact direct selection.

anatomy.name: status
anatomy.description: Polite current media position and label announcement.

variants.name: default
variants.description: Manual rich-media selection with image detail delegated to Lightbox.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: Parent-sized gallery whose internal rail mode responds at its 48rem container threshold.

states.name: default
states.description: Exactly one stable media id is current.

states.name: currentMedia
states.description: Visible discriminated record; all noncurrent records are natively hidden.

states.name: currentControl
states.description: Every rendered selector group reflects the same current id.

states.name: inactiveRichMedia
states.description: Poster plus explicit activation before any video/provider/model lifecycle is created.

states.name: finiteBoundary
states.description: Real collection boundary when loop is false.

states.name: imageDetail
states.description: Current image can open canonical synchronized Lightbox when enabled.

behavior.name: controlledCurrentId
behavior.description: The product coordinator owns one stable current media id and variant synchronization. An adapter may expose an uncontrolled initial id over the same state but must not run a second enhancer.

behavior.name: discriminatedCollection
behavior.description: Neutral records discriminate image, video, external-video, and model. Source objects, URLs, responsive delivery, provider configuration, model capability, and localization remain target data.

behavior.name: manualSelection
behavior.description: Named Buttons and horizontal swipe change only the current id; media items never advance automatically.

behavior.name: finiteOrLoop
behavior.description: Finite mode disables real bounds; loop mode wraps logical state without cloning media records or controls.

behavior.name: explicitRichActivation
behavior.description: Selection retains the poster. Hosted/provider video and models load or play only after an explicit action; changing current pauses and releases the previous lifecycle.

behavior.name: nativeMediaBoundary
behavior.description: Video/provider controls, model viewer/fullscreen, and eligible explicit AR remain native adapter capabilities and are never treated as image zoom.

behavior.name: imageDetail
behavior.description: lightbox mode composes canonical Lightbox over the image subset and synchronizes the same current id; none keeps the image passive for already-modal contexts such as Quick View.

behavior.name: mediaText
behavior.description: Informative images and posters use item-specific alternatives; decorative thumbnail previews use null alt; selection controls and status remain localized.

behavior.name: containerLayout
behavior.description: The side thumbnail rail responds to the gallery container, not the page viewport.

properties.name: imageDetail
properties.description: Semantic image-detail mode. lightbox composes canonical Lightbox; none leaves featured images passive.

properties.name: loop
properties.description: Wraps previous/next and swipe across collection bounds without cloning records.

accessibility: Keep one current stable id and synchronize hidden media, every aria-current selector, navigation bounds, and polite status together.
Use native named Buttons for direct selection and previous/next; swipe is supplementary and never the only navigation path.
Keep video/provider controls native, require explicit Play, require explicit View in 3D and AR, and release inactive media lifecycles.
Use item-specific alt for informative images/posters, null alt for previews inside named controls, visible media-type Badges, and localized action names.
Delegate image modal focus, dismissal, restoration, swipe, zoom, pan, reduced motion, forced colors, and RTL behavior to canonical Lightbox.
Preserve visible focus and semantic touch targets; do not claim Tabs or Listbox without their complete relationships and keyboard models.

web.notes: Canonical CSS and opt-in stable-id enhancer support rich records, explicit deferred activation, release, swipe, loop and synchronized Lightbox. Controlled framework renderers omit the enhancer.

shopify.notes: Maps product.media image/video/external_video/model with native filters, deferred explicit activation, media badges, eligible Shopify XR action, controlled current-id event surface, and imageDetail none/lightbox.

react.notes: Shared Exhibit/Studio renderer accepts a discriminated collection and controlled current id; targets inject native rich-media content.
